title: SigAtelier terminal atelier
description: The Signature Terminal Atelier is a Signature original: a terminal workspace manager where window/pane layouts with startup commands are declared in SigLayout files and restored with one command — the Signature take on terminal workspaces. Its layout format, engine, and sharing model are original Signature designs.

demo.program:
print('atelier open ai  # workspace restored, one command')
print('edition: Signature original')
demo.expected_output:
atelier open ai  # workspace restored, one command
edition: Signature original
